hooks.command: input=$(cat); agent=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '(.agent_type // .teammate_type // .agent // .name // "") | ascii_downcase' 2>/dev/null); task=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '(.task // .current_task // .description // .status // "")' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$agent" | grep -qE 'migration-worker|debugger|independent-reviewer' && ! echo "$task" | grep -qiE 'build|make check|make$'; then ctx=$(claude -p "Read next.md for the current migration objective. This project's teammate '$agent' just went idle mid-task (task context: $task). Act as the Explore agent: run a TARGETED, read-only search (grep/glob/read only, no edits) for donor implementation, target implementation, key symbols, existing target APIs, or assets that are likely still needed to finish this task. Return 5-15 concise, high-value findings with file:line references, oriented toward unblocking implementation. Do not write or edit any files." 2>/dev/null); jq -n --arg ctx "$ctx" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"TeammateIdle",additionalContext:$ctx}}' 2>/dev/null || echo '{}'; else echo '{}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Idle teammate on a code fix/review — checking for missing info via Explore...
